issue.title: [auth-v1 08/08] Protect every existing route with the shared auth middleware (#143)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #353

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed to branch `bb/relay-143-auth-v1-08-08-protect-every-existing-r-thr_iex8t73668`.

## Summary

Implements issue #143: every existing route now sits behind the shared session-auth middleware (`authenticateRequest`, from issue #140), with a single documented list of the exceptions that stay public.

**Changes:**
- `aiUsageHandler.ts`, `approvalRequestsHandler.ts`, `agentRunHandler.ts`, `mcpAgentPageHandler.ts`: replaced the stopgap `SEMPREC_API_TOKEN` shared-secret check with `authenticateRequest(pool, req)`, called as the first step inside each handler's existing try/catch (which already mapped `UnauthorizedError` to a 401).
- `serve.ts`: no longer requires `SEMPREC_API_TOKEN` at startup — that mechanism is fully retired.
- `app.ts` (new): extracted `createDispatcher(pool, options)` from `serve.ts` so the full route wiring can be exercised in tests without a real process.
- `routeMatrix.ts` (new): the single documented artifact of every HTTP route this service answers, tagged `public`/protected, with a `publicReason` required for each public one — currently: login, password-reset request/consume (#142), and `/api/setup` (#233/#234). Its header comment also records the investigation findings for the other surfaces the issue asked about: no WS-upgrade route is live anywhere in the repo, module routes are in-process only, the web client has no router/login page yet (so no view-path guard applies beyond the already-public setup wizard), and no health-probe endpoints exist.
- `__tests__/routeMatrix.test.ts` (new): boots the real dispatcher and, for every `ROUTE_MATRIX` entry, asserts unauthenticated requests get 401 unless marked public — this is the route-matrix test the issue's acceptance criteria require.
- Rewrote the 4 affected handler test files to authenticate via real login sessions instead of the old shared-secret token.
- Removed the now-dead `SEMPREC_API_TOKEN` proxy wiring from `web/vite.config.ts` and updated a stale comment referencing it in `web/src/api/setupOperations.ts`.

**Verification:** backend unit (114), integration (756, including the new route-matrix and rewritten auth tests), and e2e (5) tiers all pass; backend build, lint, and module-boundary check are clean; web typecheck, test suite (139), and lint are clean.

Fixed the "Backend — format check" CI failure on PR #353: `pnpm run format` had not been run on 5 files added/edited for issue #143 (`app.ts`, `routeMatrix.ts`, and 3 rewritten handler test files). Applied Prettier formatting and re-verified everything:

- Backend build, lint, `check:boundaries`, and `format:check`: all clean
- Backend unit (114), integration (756), and e2e (5) test tiers: all passing
- Web typecheck, lint, `format:check`, and test suite (139): all passing

## Summary

Addressed the AI code review's blocking finding on PR #353: the setup wizard's view path (issue #234) was only mentioned in `routeMatrix.ts`'s header comment, not as an explicit entry in the documented exceptions list. Added a `surface: "view"` entry for it, and split `RouteMatrixEntry` into `"api"` (fetch-tested against the real dispatcher) vs `"view"` (client-side-only paths this backend doesn't serve, listed for the record) so the route-matrix test doesn't claim to verify a route it can't actually reach. Also applied the review's low-priority suggestion, swapping a hardcoded test email for `randomUUID()` in `aiUsageHandler.test.ts` for consistency with the other rewritten handler tests.

Verified: backend build, `format:check`, `lint`, `check:boundaries` all clean; backend unit (114), integration (756), and e2e (5) tiers all pass; web typecheck, `format:check`, `lint`, and test suite (139) all pass.
